name: claude-mods
description: Claude Code mods: session board, shell guard, handoff with new session, large-output warning, and more

plugins.name: brain-dump
plugins.description: Catches a long messy prompt, asks a few questions about it, and sends it as the task, the why, the guardrails and what done looks like

plugins.name: cache-clock
plugins.description: Counts down to the moment this chat's prompt cache goes cold, and can keep it warm with one cheap touch

plugins.name: chat-inventory
plugins.description: /inventory shows the goal, the task list, every connector and skill used, and the files touched in this chat

plugins.name: dokument
plugins.description: Fills a template from sabloni/ ({{field}} placeholders) into a new dated file; never overwrites, never writes with a field missing

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Writes tasks/handoff.md for a fresh chat (at 110k tokens, when the chat goes cold, or on /handoff) and offers a new session that starts with it as context

plugins.name: helper-desk
plugins.description: A progress band above the prompt and a panel with one row per subagent: its colour, its progress and what it cost

plugins.name: n8n
plugins.description: Read-only view of the local n8n: workflows, failed executions and why they failed, as tools for Claude and a /n8n summary

plugins.name: novi-klijent
plugins.description: Sets up a new client app step by step (GitHub repo, Vercel, Neon, dimi-cli registry); each step shows its command and runs only after an explicit da

plugins.name: objave
plugins.description: Social media posting schedule in objave.json, with what is due today in the status line; never posts anything itself

plugins.name: ps-straza
plugins.description: Shell guard: refuses disk-wiping commands outright and asks before force-push, hard reset, DROP, reboot, HKLM edits and production deploys

plugins.name: reflect
plugins.description: Catches a hard standing rule in a prompt and asks where to save it: memory, CLAUDE.md, or the vault

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: /replay steps through every change Claude made to a file in this chat and puts an earlier version back

plugins.name: screen-share
plugins.description: /screen-share replaces emails, phone numbers, money amounts and words you name with grey bars, so the screen is safe to show

plugins.name: switchboard
plugins.description: /mods lists every mod on this machine and toggles it or its panes off

plugins.name: tabla
plugins.description: One pane for every open Claude session (project, state, context) and a phone push when a long turn ends or a session asks for permission

plugins.name: trening
plugins.description: Watches an ML training log: loss, step, ETA and GPU in the status line, and a phone push when training finishes, crashes or stalls

plugins.name: veliki-izlaz
plugins.description: Warns when a tool's output in the main thread passes ~15k tokens: a toast for the person and a nudge for the model to delegate such work to a subagent
